decision.reasoning_trace: I evaluated the selection by focusing on functional backpacks rather than the various camping accessories mixed into the category. The Gelindo 18L-Hiking Hydration Backpack (prod_backpacks_078) emerged as the best option due to its high rating (4.7) and specific positive feedback regarding its utility for festivals and hiking. I also considered the DeMarini baseball backpack and the OutdoorMaster boot bag, which are high quality but very niche for specific sports. The Fox Outdoor NATO rucksack offered a classic aesthetic but had some negative feedback regarding the quality of the buckles, and the vimapo foldable bag was viewed as less durable for daily needs. Ultimately, the Gelindo provided the best balance of price, features, and user satisfaction.
